class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Use Gemini Spark to manage your tasks &amp; workflows in Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini Spark is your personal AI agent that can automate complex workflows and manage schedules for ongoing tasks in Gemini Apps. Gemini can help handle tasks, using info from sources like Connected Apps, skills, chats, websites you’re signed into, Personal Intelligence, location, and more. Just tell Gemini your specific goals and when you want tasks completed.</p>

<p>For example, you can use Spark to:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Declutter your inbox:</strong> Summarize or archive newsletters and unsubscribe from emails lists.</li>
  <li><strong>Get a custom news digest</strong>: Go deep on the stories you care about and follow how they evolve</li>
  <li><strong>Deep dive on topics:</strong> Pull research formatted to fit your goal, complete with cited sources</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> Schedules in Gemini Spark are different from scheduled actions in Gemini chats. <a href="/gemini/answer/16316416?" rel="noopener">Learn how to schedule actions in Gemini Apps</a>.</p>

<h2 id="reqs">What you need</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>To use Gemini Spark, you must:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Be 18 or over</strong>.</li>
  <li><strong>Sign in to the Gemini app with a personal Google Account.</strong> For now, this feature isn’t available if you sign in with a work or school Google Account. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Have a Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription.</strong> <a href="/gemini/answer/14517446" rel="noopener">Learn how to upgrade</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Have <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Keep Activity</a> on</strong>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong> For now, Gemini Spark is:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Available wherever Gemini Apps are supported, except in the European Economic Area, Nigeria, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.</li>
  <li>Only available in the Gemini mobile app, the Gemini app on Mac, and the Gemini web app at <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="before_using_gemini_spark">Before you use Gemini Spark</h2>
<a class="zippy" id="sensitive_info" name="sensitive_info">​Be careful when you enter info directly in a task thread​</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Do not enter sign-in info, payment details, or info you may find sensitive directly into the task thread. If needed, take control of Gemini’s browser or the local browser. Then, enter relevant details directly on the webpage.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="senstivie_tasks" name="senstivie_tasks">Avoid scheduling tasks you find sensitive</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini is still learning and can make mistakes. To help keep your information safe and prevent unintended actions, avoid tasks or schedules that use information or perform actions that you find sensitive. These tasks may need your supervision and input.</p>

<p>If a schedule runs when you are offline, you may not be able to stop Gemini from completing an unintended action. Some tasks may require your confirmation before Gemini completes them. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094710" rel="noopener">Learn more about tasks and schedules</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="spark_gic" name="spark_gic">How Spark works with Gemini in Chrome</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>With Chrome auto browse, you can ask Gemini Spark to complete tasks that involve browsing the web, like shopping, booking travel, or making dinner reservations. To work on your tasks, Spark uses your info from sources like Connected Apps, skills, chats, tasks, websites you’re logged into, Personal Intelligence, location, <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini?p=lm_agent_sources" rel="noopener">and more</a>.</p>

<p>Gemini Spark can browse the web in multiple ways, one of which is by connecting to your own device (aka your local Chrome browser). Currently, only Gemini Spark in desktop Chrome can use auto browse. It might also use a remote browser (which is a separate, new browser instance, not your local browser in the cloud).</p>

<p><strong>If you use your local browser:</strong> Gemini Spark has access to all the same sites that you do, including sites you’re signed into. When acting on your behalf, Gemini Spark will share necessary info with third parties. This could include your name, contact information, files, preferences, and info you might find sensitive. With your permission, it can also use login info you saved in Password Manager to sign into loyalty programs and online accounts.</p>

<p>To use Spark via your local browser, you’ll need to keep your device and Google Chrome awake and running. If you later close or turn off your device before the task is finished, or the device isn’t available, Spark might use a remote browser to complete the task.</p>

<p>If you use the remote browser: Your task can continue even if you close your device. Note that at some stages -- like when a website asks you to sign in -- the task will stop until you take over and do it yourself.</p>

<p><strong>Notes:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>The first time Gemini Spark needs to browse the web for you on this device, Chrome will ask you for permission to connect Chrome to Spark.</li>
  <li>After that, for every task that involves web browsing, Spark will ask for confirmation first.</li>
  <li>You can turn off Gemini Spark’s ability to autobrowse on a device. Click More<strong> </strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Settings</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>AI Innovations</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Gemini in Chrome</strong>.</li>
</ul>

<h4>Keep track of tasks</h4>

<p>If Gemini Spark is busy using auto browse for a task, you’ll see it in your <a href="https://gemini.google.com/corp/spark/tasks" rel="noopener">Recent Tasks</a>. At any time, you can stop Gemini from web browsing. In the Gemini in Chrome side panel, click Stop <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/8QtjORLfdGEtXJDJ3unfCOaRzMnKQo5-2GwB1OTMyvkOFRyVGtnqa1OsfMJcvIzAQPI=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/8QtjORLfdGEtXJDJ3unfCOaRzMnKQo5-2GwB1OTMyvkOFRyVGtnqa1OsfMJcvIzAQPI">. If you do, Gemini tries to figure out the next steps to continue your task. This may involve use of the remote browser to web browse or activation of a different tool. Or it could mean that Gemini abandons the task.</p>

<p>If you want to completely cancel a task yourself, in the Gemini Spark text box, click Stop <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/8QtjORLfdGEtXJDJ3unfCOaRzMnKQo5-2GwB1OTMyvkOFRyVGtnqa1OsfMJcvIzAQPI=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/8QtjORLfdGEtXJDJ3unfCOaRzMnKQo5-2GwB1OTMyvkOFRyVGtnqa1OsfMJcvIzAQPI">.</p>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="gs_spark">Get started with Gemini Spark</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>You can get help with setting up your first skills and tasks in Gemini Spark conversationally. Just enter “set up,” “get started,” or “interview me” in a Gemini Spark task.</p>

<p><a href="#sources" rel="noopener">Learn what Gemini Spark can use for your tasks</a>.</p>
</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="17103227"></gkms-context-selector><h2 id="create_task">Create a task</h2>
<a class="zippy zippy-expand" id="create_task_web" name="create_task_web">In the Gemini web app</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>On the sidebar, click Switch to Spark <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9AacHfbCpEr5Bt6D8QFHxyQW5SR6P_PNlLYfOPDYiJZ_xJMnWRrPi8d6uXKPSemIH7oF=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9AacHfbCpEr5Bt6D8QFHxyQW5SR6P_PNlLYfOPDYiJZ_xJMnWRrPi8d6uXKPSemIH7oF">.</li>
  <li>In the text box, describe the task you want Gemini to manage.
    <ul>
      <li>You can tell Gemini when to run the task, like around a specific time or after an event. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094710" rel="noopener">Learn more about schedules</a>.</li>
      <li>To specify an existing skill to use, enter <code>/</code>, then select the skill. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094296" rel="noopener">Learn more about skills</a>.</li>
      <li>You can also tell Gemini to use a custom connected app. <a href="/gemini/answer/17209137" rel="noopener">Learn how to connect custom apps</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>To add files to your task, click Upload &amp; tools <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc">, then one of the following options:
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Upload files</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq"></li>
      <li><strong>Add from Drive</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/G0gtMhFiQ4HhPVBnXnqrH6DX4JqcJrJ7OHCKmY-zOSmaI4T0aCDAiicTTbzhpgsPKA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/G0gtMhFiQ4HhPVBnXnqrH6DX4JqcJrJ7OHCKmY-zOSmaI4T0aCDAiicTTbzhpgsPKA"></li>
      <li><strong>Add Notebook</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Notebook" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU"></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa">.</li>
  <li>Monitor your task regularly for any input Gemini may need from you. For example, if Gemini needs you to perform certain actions in its browser, it asks you to take over the task.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="create_task_mac" name="create_task_mac">In the Gemini app on Mac</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your Mac, open Gemini <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>On the sidebar, click <strong>Spark</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Tasks <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/NOt6SFIfyn1unnDryHijjl5JhYtAWY9nAe3z1ww2mo3PKcARFTV3cnchDv34bfwODC46=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/NOt6SFIfyn1unnDryHijjl5JhYtAWY9nAe3z1ww2mo3PKcARFTV3cnchDv34bfwODC46">.</li>
  <li>In the text box, describe the task you want Gemini to manage.
    <ul>
      <li>You can tell Gemini when to run the task, like around a specific time or after an event. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094710" rel="noopener">Learn more about schedules</a>.</li>
      <li>To specify an existing skill to use, enter / or @, then select the skill. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094296" rel="noopener">Learn more about skills</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>To add files to your task, click Upload &amp; tools <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc">, then one of the following options:
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Upload files</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq"></li>
      <li><strong>Add from Drive</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/G0gtMhFiQ4HhPVBnXnqrH6DX4JqcJrJ7OHCKmY-zOSmaI4T0aCDAiicTTbzhpgsPKA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/G0gtMhFiQ4HhPVBnXnqrH6DX4JqcJrJ7OHCKmY-zOSmaI4T0aCDAiicTTbzhpgsPKA"></li>
      <li><strong>Add Notebook</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Notebook" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU"></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa">.</li>
  <li>Monitor your task regularly for any input Gemini may need from you. For example, if Gemini needs you to perform certain actions in its browser, it asks you to take over the task.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <p><strong>Tip:</strong> If Gemini Spark is set up on your Mac, you can ask Gemini to take action on your Mac from another device. <a href="/gemini/answer/17208717#remote_control" rel="noopener">Learn how to control the Gemini app on Mac remotely</a>.</p>
</div>

<h3 id="example_tasks">Example tasks</h3>

<div class="no-margin"><ul>
  <li>Declutter your inbox: Summarize or archive newsletters and unsubscribe from emails lists.</li>
  <li>Get a custom news digest: Go deep on the stories you care about and follow how they evolve</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="monitor_tasks"><a id="work_panel" name="work_panel"></a>Monitor a task &amp; check its progress</h2>

<p>To check and manage a task, including any associated permissions and schedules, open the task thread and its work panel.</p>

<h3 id="open_panel">Step 1: Open the task thread &amp; its work panel</h3>
<a class="zippy zippy-expand" id="open_panel_web" name="open_panel_web">In the Gemini web app</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>On the sidebar, click Switch to Spark <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9AacHfbCpEr5Bt6D8QFHxyQW5SR6P_PNlLYfOPDYiJZ_xJMnWRrPi8d6uXKPSemIH7oF=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9AacHfbCpEr5Bt6D8QFHxyQW5SR6P_PNlLYfOPDYiJZ_xJMnWRrPi8d6uXKPSemIH7oF"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Tasks</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/NOt6SFIfyn1unnDryHijjl5JhYtAWY9nAe3z1ww2mo3PKcARFTV3cnchDv34bfwODC46=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/NOt6SFIfyn1unnDryHijjl5JhYtAWY9nAe3z1ww2mo3PKcARFTV3cnchDv34bfwODC46">.</li>
  <li>Click the thread for the task you want to check or manage.</li>
  <li>To give Gemini more instructions or change them, tell Gemini in the task thread.</li>
  <li>To show this task thread’s work panel, on the left edge of the thread panel, click Close tasks panel <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/l6pu6O363aJokFFXeV7YmuvDgqnCxW0NmzKDsJn_31AmDCvjGZJ2LFkW_mA5Sps3KX0=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/l6pu6O363aJokFFXeV7YmuvDgqnCxW0NmzKDsJn_31AmDCvjGZJ2LFkW_mA5Sps3KX0">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <p><strong>Tip:</strong> For a quick view of a task thread’s work panel, at the top of the thread, click the progress chip.</p>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="open_panel_mac" name="open_panel_mac">In the Gemini app on Mac</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your Mac, open the Gemini app <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>On the sidebar, click <strong>Spark</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;Tasks <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/NOt6SFIfyn1unnDryHijjl5JhYtAWY9nAe3z1ww2mo3PKcARFTV3cnchDv34bfwODC46=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/NOt6SFIfyn1unnDryHijjl5JhYtAWY9nAe3z1ww2mo3PKcARFTV3cnchDv34bfwODC46">.</li>
  <li>Click the thread for the task you want to check or manage.</li>
  <li>To give Gemini more instructions or change them, tell Gemini in the task thread.</li>
  <li>To show this task thread’s work panel, on the left edge of the thread panel, click Close tasks panel <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/l6pu6O363aJokFFXeV7YmuvDgqnCxW0NmzKDsJn_31AmDCvjGZJ2LFkW_mA5Sps3KX0=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/l6pu6O363aJokFFXeV7YmuvDgqnCxW0NmzKDsJn_31AmDCvjGZJ2LFkW_mA5Sps3KX0">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <p><strong>Tip:</strong> For a quick view of a task thread’s work panel, at the top of the thread, click the progress chip.</p>
</div>

<h3 id="manage_tasks">Step 2: Check &amp; manage tasks in the work panel</h3>
<a class="zippy" id="check_progress" name="check_progress">Check the progress &amp; steps completed in a thread</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Under “Progress,” you can find the steps and progress of tasks in a thread.</p>

<table>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/VaANVDjn1LeSZcT0zCqcBJpBA0xB_IWaZ3oRwh0zW0cDuNXWX7BbufJHLzCOuYrZFL4=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/VaANVDjn1LeSZcT0zCqcBJpBA0xB_IWaZ3oRwh0zW0cDuNXWX7BbufJHLzCOuYrZFL4"><br>
      <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3QMrUt9SZY2H3dg49mk91t_1cy_lCkb3O501XHQxpnySUxL3wFoRBEypaUFk1FkrZw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3QMrUt9SZY2H3dg49mk91t_1cy_lCkb3O501XHQxpnySUxL3wFoRBEypaUFk1FkrZw"><br>
      <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/xNAQ3dsLerfZQ62tmKzXpTtTTYJWn5QMdUNqRr6i-l9DDoCunsnHWIlqa48InBUmJjg=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/xNAQ3dsLerfZQ62tmKzXpTtTTYJWn5QMdUNqRr6i-l9DDoCunsnHWIlqa48InBUmJjg"></td>
      <td>Completed step<br>
      Current step<br>
      Planned step</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="check_files" name="check_files">Check files Gemini read or updated</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin">Under “Files,” you can review the files that Gemini read or updated for tasks in the thread. You can click a file to open it.</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="pause_resume" name="pause_resume">Pause &amp; resume schedules in a thread</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>Under “Schedules,” hover over the schedule you want to pause or resume.</li>
  <li>To pause a schedule, click More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Pause</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/GHEiEVePmOtciEq32kdmwtLe-KuNDWYBc9GkBTa_p8a4grHKxMK1lGneesxxVTXtIX0=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/GHEiEVePmOtciEq32kdmwtLe-KuNDWYBc9GkBTa_p8a4grHKxMK1lGneesxxVTXtIX0">.</li>
  <li>To resume a schedule, click More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Resume</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/KNVK30CqXKoO_O0nbxKjmK5BgRtCaekLBcJUy5dosa8reAElnyRzlPlLsXS9HghXqw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/KNVK30CqXKoO_O0nbxKjmK5BgRtCaekLBcJUy5dosa8reAElnyRzlPlLsXS9HghXqw">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <p><strong>Tip:</strong> In the Gemini web app, you can also pause and resume schedules from the Schedules page. Learn how to manage your schedules.</p>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="monitor" name="monitor">Monitor &amp; take over a task</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini can complete some of your tasks in a local or remote browser. For example, it can navigate to a website and interact with the page, like adding items to your cart. You can take control of the browser at any time. For certain actions, Gemini will ask you to take over the task.</p>
</div>

  <div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Take over remote browser tasks</strong></p>

<ol>
  <li>Open the task’s work panel.</li>
  <li>Under “Skills &amp; apps,” click <strong>Remote browser</strong>. This opens Gemini’s browser on a remote computer.
    <ul>
      <li>When Gemini is browsing the web, there’s a Remote computer icon <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/aBCRQD01acPf1jiYFp5LXeEzMfuhnRToBYt2oDdP0GwILKy5Q59DpaDf-fXLxrtnWEc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/aBCRQD01acPf1jiYFp5LXeEzMfuhnRToBYt2oDdP0GwILKy5Q59DpaDf-fXLxrtnWEc"> at the top of the task thread. You can also click Remote computer <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/aBCRQD01acPf1jiYFp5LXeEzMfuhnRToBYt2oDdP0GwILKy5Q59DpaDf-fXLxrtnWEc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/aBCRQD01acPf1jiYFp5LXeEzMfuhnRToBYt2oDdP0GwILKy5Q59DpaDf-fXLxrtnWEc"> to view Gemini’s browser.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Hover over Gemini’s browser.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Take over task</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/E7fFVA5ZHr1S_lG7OR69Mu99NSwEhPJG4kHhP_aHSZbhSwBnqDxYMkZEnEXt55M65vA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/E7fFVA5ZHr1S_lG7OR69Mu99NSwEhPJG4kHhP_aHSZbhSwBnqDxYMkZEnEXt55M65vA"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Take over task</strong>.</li>
  <li>Complete your steps.</li>
  <li>To give back control to Gemini, at the top, click <strong>Go back to Gemini</strong>.</li>
</ol>

<p><strong>Take over local browser tasks</strong></p>

<p><a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16821166" rel="noopener">Learn how to manage tasks completed with Chrome auto browse</a>.</p>
</div>

  <p><strong>Tip:</strong> <a href="#open_panel" rel="noopener">Learn how to open the work panel</a>.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="delete_data">Delete remote browser &amp; computer data</h2>
<a class="zippy" id="local_data" name="local_data">Delete local browser data</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin">You can remove data from the Chrome browser on your device at any time. <a href="https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/2392709" rel="noopener">Learn how to delete your local browser data in Chrome</a>.</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="delete_browser_data" name="delete_browser_data">Delete remote browser data</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>When Gemini uses the remote browser to complete tasks, browser data, like cookies that contain your website authentication info (your sign-in details), is saved for future sessions for your convenience. You can delete all saved browser data from past sessions, at any time. To help protect your privacy, Gemini may automatically delete saved browser data on your behalf, and you may need to sign back in to websites.</p>
</div>

  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>

<h2 id="turn_off_spark">Turn off Gemini Spark&nbsp;</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong> When Gemini Spark is turned off:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Your remote browser data and remote code execution data is deleted.</li>
  <li>Your Chrome browsing data is not erased. <a href="https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/2392709" rel="noopener">Learn how to delete your local browser data in Chrome</a>.</li>
  <li>Schedules will not run as long as Spark is off or if your device is off.</li>
  <li>Your tasks, threads, schedules, or any related files that Gemini updated or created will not be deleted.</li>

<h2 id="sources">What Gemini Spark can use to work on your tasks</h2>

<p>When you use Spark, Gemini uses info from available sources, such as the features listed below, and info from websites it interacts with, including those you are logged into.</p>
<a class="zippy" id="source_skills_schedules" name="source_skills_schedules">Skills &amp; schedules</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini Spark can use:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Skills:</strong> reusable instructions with additional context. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094296" rel="noopener">Learn how to create and manage skills</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Schedules:</strong> automated triggers for a task that tell Gemini Spark when to execute your instructions. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094710" rel="noopener">Learn how to create and manage schedules</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="source_apps_services" name="source_apps_services">Connected Apps &amp; other Google services</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini Spark can use some Connected Apps and certain Google services for your tasks, including:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Custom apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/17209137" rel="noopener">Learn how to connect custom apps</a>.</li>
  <li>These Google Connected Apps and services:
    <ul>
      <li>Contacts, which include Google Contacts and contact info from your signed-in devices.</li>
      <li>Gemini Notebook.</li>
      <li>Google Workspace, which includes Calendar, Docs, Drive, Gmail, Keep, Sheets, Slides, and Tasks. <a href="#workspace_actions" rel="noopener">Learn which actions are supported</a>.</li>
      <li>Google Search services, which includes Search, Finance, Flights, Hotels, and Maps.</li>
      <li>YouTube.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Several third-party apps.</li>
</ul>

<p>To check which Connected Apps are available in Gemini Spark, <a href="/gemini/table/17434654" rel="noopener">review the Connected Apps list</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="source_remote_browser_computer" name="source_remote_browser_computer">Remote browser &amp; computer</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini Spark can use a remote browser with automatically saved info and remote computer with code execution data for your tasks. <a href="#delete_data" rel="noopener">Learn how to delete remote browser and computer data</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="source_pi" name="source_pi">Personal Intelligence</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini Spark can use Personal Intelligence, which includes:</p>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/16598469" rel="noopener">Memory of your past Gemini chats</a></li>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/16598625" rel="noopener">Instructions for Gemini</a></li>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/16598406" rel="noopener">Google Connected Apps that work with Personal Intelligence</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="other_gemini_features" name="other_gemini_features">Other Gemini features</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Below are some of Gemini’s other features that Gemini Spark can use to work on your tasks.</p>

<p><strong>Canvas panel for Google Docs</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>In the Gemini web app at <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>, you can edit Google documents that Gemini Spark creates in the Canvas panel.</li>
  <li>When Gemini Spark uses Canvas, the “Create” menu and certain quick edit options in Canvas are not available.</li>
</ul>

<p><a href="/gemini/answer/16047321" rel="noopener">Learn more about Canvas</a></p>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="limits">Limits on Gemini Spark tasks</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini Apps have compute-based usage limits that determine how much you can interact with Gemini tools and features. These usage limits increase with higher Google AI subscriptions. How much of your usage is consumed by Gemini Spark will depend on how many requests you make using Gemini Spark each day and how complex each request is. If you’re close to your limit, Gemini lets you know. <a href="/gemini/answer/16275805" rel="noopener">Learn more about limits in Gemini Apps</a>.</p>

<p>You can have up to 15 tasks running at a given time. You'll have to wait for tasks to be completed before making another request. Also, a schedule will not run if there are already 15 tasks running.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="risks_safety">How Gemini Spark works with you to keep you &amp; your info safe</h2>

<p>Gemini Spark is an experimental feature in early development. As we continuously work to improve it, your supervision is important to help prevent unintended and potentially harmful actions.</p>
<a class="zippy" id="agentic_risks" name="agentic_risks">About possible risks of using agentic AI</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Agentic AI technologies, which power some of the capabilities of Gemini Spark, are helpful and powerful tools, but it's important to be aware of some possible risks. Remember that Gemini can make mistakes and do unexpected things.</p>

<p><strong>About prompt injection</strong></p>

<p>Prompt injection is an attempt to elicit an unintended or harmful response from AI tools like Spark. This happens when content, like a website, an email, a document, .md file, or multimedia, has malicious instructions or code that might be hidden from you but visible to the AI agent.</p>

<p>If an AI agent reads these instructions while doing a task, it may be misled into doing unintended things. For example, a malicious instruction could tell the agent to:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Take your private info from your emails or documents and post it on a public website.</li>
  <li>Send your emails in Gmail to an external service without you knowing.</li>
  <li>Expose insights about you based on your data in connected apps.</li>
  <li>Run a command that can be malicious or install compromised software, to achieve persistent data exfiltration through arbitrary code execution. To help protect against this, you can delete your remote browser data and clear your code execution history and files in your Gemini Spark settings.</li>
</ul>

<h4>Gemini can share your info with websites</h4>

<p>When you use Spark, Gemini can share information from your chat and other available sources, like your Connected Apps and Personal Intelligence, with websites while using the local or remote browser. This could include your name, contact info, files, preferences, and info you might find sensitive. This can create privacy risks, for example when Spark uses connected apps like Google Workspace which allow Gemini to access your private info. Gemini can choose sites to visit to fulfill your request.&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>Gemini has access to your local browsing state</strong></p>

<p>When using the local browser Chrome, Gemini Spark has access to the same sites that you do, including sites you're signed into.&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="spark_safety" name="spark_safety">How Spark helps you keep your info safe&nbsp;</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><div>To help reduce <a href="/gemini/answer/17094507#agentic_risks" rel="noopener">possible risks associated</a> with the use of AI agents, Gemini Spark includes features designed to support safer use and mitigate the likelihood of unintended or potentially harmful actions. While these do not guarantee protection against all risks, these features include:</div>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Prompts for user confirmation:</strong> Gemini is designed to ask for your review and confirmation before it completes certain actions, such as:

    <ul>
      <li>Sending communications, modifying your data, making purchases, and submitting web forms.</li>
      <li>Before starting a browser task, Gemini will choose which sites to use to complete the task, and it may share your personal info with those sites.
        <ul>
          <li>Review the plan Gemini in Chrome will use. Check that it understood your prompt, the page context, and your personal info correctly.</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Prohibited task recognition:</strong> Gemini has safeguards designed to help it recognize and not act on certain types of requests that could be harmful or are outside of its intended purpose, including certain tasks that may violate the <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy" rel="noopener">Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy</a>.</li>
  <li>“<strong>Take control” mode:</strong> Gemini may pause and ask you to “take control” of the browser to complete specific actions, including entering specific types of information (such as passwords or payment details).</li>
  <li><strong>Planning info:</strong> Gemini is designed to show you what it’s planning to do after you submit a prompt, its progress as it works on your task, and any relevant Skills, Connected Apps, and files used or created.</li>
  <li><strong>Site and action restrictions:</strong> Spark restricts its browsing activity to the websites and actions relevant to your task. This helps protect your data on other unrelated sites and helps prevent actions that don't align with your task. These are just some ways we protect against prompt injection.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="supervision" name="supervision">Why your supervision is important &amp; how to stop Gemini</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini’s safeguards for Spark described above don’t guarantee protection against all risks.</p>

<h4>Supervise important &amp; sensitive tasks</h4>

<div>Your active supervision is the most important way to protect against risk while using Spark. Review confirmation requests and clarifying questions closely. Use Spark carefully and safely, and only give Spark tasks you're comfortable with. Be extra watchful when Gemini:</div>

<ul>
  <li>Handles an important task</li>
  <li>Is signed in to websites with sensitive access or info you find sensitive</li>
  <li>Does anything where a mistake could be a problem</li>
  <li>Uses connected apps, like Google Workspace</li>
  <li>Requires sharing data that you consider sensitive.</li>
</ul>

<h4>You’re in control</h4>

<p>If Gemini is doing something you don't like, you can stop it by selecting Stop response <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/oUuvfQv_WUbsvIhwd3LX03hooJJL-ES3IeYPU7vATeCq0K9v0fbhcwuFD4UsjNbIaDQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/oUuvfQv_WUbsvIhwd3LX03hooJJL-ES3IeYPU7vATeCq0K9v0fbhcwuFD4UsjNbIaDQ">&nbsp; in the chat or Take control <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/E7fFVA5ZHr1S_lG7OR69Mu99NSwEhPJG4kHhP_aHSZbhSwBnqDxYMkZEnEXt55M65vA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/E7fFVA5ZHr1S_lG7OR69Mu99NSwEhPJG4kHhP_aHSZbhSwBnqDxYMkZEnEXt55M65vA"> over Gemini’s browser. Gemini’s safeguards aren’t intended to replace your active supervision. You can also help keep your info safe by deleting your local or remote browser data and remote computer data after sensitive sessions.&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="common_questions">Common questions</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><a class="zippy" id="task_schedule_skill" name="task_schedule_skill">What's the difference between a task, schedule, and skill?</a>
<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>To help you get the most out of Spark tasks, it’s helpful to understand the three building blocks that power its logic: tasks, schedules, and skills. Think of these as the what, when, and how.</p>

<p><strong>A task is your high-level goal.</strong> It represents a complete project or objective you want Gemini Spark to manage for you.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Example:</strong> "Plan and manage my business trip to London."</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>A schedule lets you hand over tasks</strong> to Gemini Spark so they run automatically in the background. You tell Gemini what to do and when to do it. Tasks can be scheduled to run at a specific date and time or in response to an event.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Example:</strong> "Every day at 8AM (condition), give me an update on AI news (task)"</li>
  <li><strong>Example:</strong> "When my flight is delayed (condition), notify me and propose an update to my itinerary (task)."</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> Schedules in Gemini Spark are different from scheduled actions in Gemini chat. <a href="/gemini/answer/16316416" rel="noopener">Learn how to schedule actions in Gemini Apps</a>.</p>

<p><strong>A skill is a set of reusable instructions and additional context.</strong> It teaches Gemini how to do a specific task and what tools to use. You can specify the skill Gemini Spark should use for a task or a schedule’s action. Spark can also automatically use a skill when it’s relevant to a task.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Example:</strong> Using a "Travel Booking" skill and a "Gmail Writing" skill simultaneously to rebook a room and send a confirmation.</li>
</ul>

<p>In summary, you define the task (what you want), set the schedules (when it should happen), and provide the skills (how to do it) to complete the work.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="downgrade_cancel_ultra" name="downgrade_cancel_ultra">What happens if I cancel or downgrade my Google AI subscription?</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>If you cancel your Google AI subscription or downgrade to a subscription that doesn't support access to Gemini Spark, you will lose access to Gemini Spark, tasks, schedules, and skills. Your data is retained but some features are paused or disabled:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>In-progress Spark tasks</strong> will finish, but are not deleted.</li>
  <li><strong>Schedules</strong> will be paused, but not deleted.</li>
  <li><strong>Skills</strong> are turned off, but not deleted.</li>
</ul>

<p>To regain access and resume these features, you’ll need to upgrade or resubscribe to a Google AI subscription that supports Gemini Spark. <a href="/gemini/answer/14517446" rel="noopener">Learn how to manage your Google AI subscription</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="workspace_actions" name="workspace_actions">What Workspace actions can Gemini Spark perform?</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>For Spark to connect with your data in Google Workspace services, Google Workspace needs to be connected to Gemini Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044" rel="noopener">Learn how to use &amp; manage Connected Apps in Gemini</a>.</li>
  <li>To undo Gemini Spark’s action, click the link in Spark’s confirmation and make your changes in the Workspace service.</li>
</ul>

<div>Gemini Spark can take the following actions in Workspace:</div>

<h4>Calendar</h4>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Manage your schedule:</strong> Check your calendar, RSVP to invitations, and schedule new events.</li>
  <li><strong>Reschedule &amp; clean up:</strong> Update meeting times, change locations, or cancel events.</li>
  <li><strong>Smart scheduling:</strong> Check your calendar and suggest open slots that fit everyone's availability.</li>
</ul>

<h4>Gmail</h4>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Search &amp; summarize emails:</strong> Search across your email threads to find specific topics or summarize conversations.</li>
  <li><strong>Draft &amp; reply:</strong> Compose email drafts, forward emails, or reply to existing email threads.</li>
  <li><strong>Use labels:</strong> Organize your inbox with labels.</li>
</ul>

<h4>Docs, Sheets, Slides, &amp; Drive</h4>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> To edit shared documents, spreadsheets, and presentations, you’ll need to review and confirm Gemini Spark’s planned edits.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Search &amp; manage your Google Drive files:</strong> Search for files, read file contents, rename or delete files, check metadata, and view recent documents.</li>
  <li><strong>Write &amp; edit documents:</strong> Create documents in Google Docs or edit existing ones—adding summaries, notes, or editing specific sections.</li>
  <li><strong>Read comments:</strong> Read comments in Google documents, spreadsheets, and presentations.</li>
  <li><strong>Create &amp; edit spreadsheets:</strong> Build, format, and edit custom spreadsheets in Google Sheets with data, tables, and formulas.</li>
  <li><strong>Generate &amp; edit presentations:</strong> Create presentations in Google Slides from a prompt, and edit, add, and remove slides in a presentation.</li>
  <li><strong>Add images to documents &amp; presentations:</strong> Add an image to your prompt and ask Gemini to add it to a document or presentation.</li>
</ul>

<h4>Google Keep</h4>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Find notes &amp; lists:</strong> Search for and retrieve notes and lists across Google Keep.</li>
  <li><strong>Create notes &amp; lists:</strong> Create private lists and notes in Google Keep.</li>
</ul>

<h4>Google Tasks</h4>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> Gemini can perform bulk actions on private tasks in Google Tasks without your confirmation. Please review your request before you submit or manage directly in Google Tasks.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Find reminders &amp; tasks:</strong> Search for and retrieve reminders and tasks from Google Tasks.</li>
  <li><strong>Manage reminders &amp; tasks:</strong> Add, update, and delete reminders and tasks in Google Tasks.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
